title: Baker Mayfield: Sunday's win was a statement of our potential

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Baker Mayfield: Sunday's win was a statement of our potential
sources.description: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield said his right thumb might be a little sore after Sunday's win over the Panthers moved the team to 2-5, but he did it with a smile because the cause of the soreness was how often he handed the ball off.
